# Qampi

> Qampi is an AI-powered LinkedIn and cold-email outreach platform for B2B. It reads each prospect's LinkedIn profile and recent posts, then writes personalized outreach that sounds genuinely human — sent safely at scale across LinkedIn and email.

Qampi's core idea: most automation blasts "Hi {FirstName}" templates, so reply rates collapse. Qampi researches every prospect and writes a message specific to them, in your voice, while keeping your LinkedIn account safe with dedicated proxies, human-like sending patterns, and automatic limit monitoring. It works for sales/lead-gen, recruiting, job seekers, fundraising, and networking. Free tier available (Qampi Fast); paid tiers (Qampi Pro) add reasoning models and deep web research.

## Key facts
- Category: LinkedIn automation / sales engagement / AI outreach.
- Personalization: reads each prospect's profile and recent posts to write an original message (not merge-tag templates).
- Channels: LinkedIn and cold email in one AI-written, sequence-aware cadence.
- Account safety: dedicated per-account ISP proxies, randomized human-like delays, working-hours sending windows, automatic weekly-limit monitoring that pauses before LinkedIn's thresholds.
- Voice: learns and writes in your voice from your own writing samples.
- CRM: native HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Notion integrations.
- Models: Qampi Fast (free, optimized) and Qampi Pro (paid, reasoning + deep web research).
- Works with standard LinkedIn accounts; Sales Navigator optional.
- Get started: https://app.qampi.com/register (no credit card, cancel anytime).
